target_customer: General contractors and constructors (estimators, pre-construction and commercial teams) bidding on large projects
problem: Contracts, specs and drawings are long and complex, so estimators miss risks, scope gaps and obligations that later become costly disputes.
product_category: AI document review for construction estimating and contract risk

founders.name: Luigi La Corte
founders.background_notes: YC page: seven years in construction as civil engineer at Arup then a Director at infrastructure developer Plenary. BetaKit: son of an immigrant general contractor.

founders.name: Brendan Ardagh
founders.background_notes: BetaKit: trained as a quantity surveyor, previously CTO of Jem HR. YC launch post: left construction and built two startups before returning. The founders met through YC in December 2021.

competitors.name: Document Crunch
competitors.what: AI contract review and risk software built for construction, Atlanta

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing long contracts, specifications and drawings and finding cross-document conflicts needed document AI work in 2022, before LLMs were common, but no hardware or research breakthrough.

defensibility.rationale: An early product could be copied by other document AI teams; later customer integrations and construction-specific data add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought or copied it according to sources found; Provision remained independent through 2025.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites roughly $500B a year (about 4 percent of market value) lost to issues from document complexity. A competitor raised seed funding for construction contract review in April 2022.

branding.domain_note: Company site is provision.com per YC; a search also showed useprovision.com on an about page. Domain history not found.

identity.logo: Small wordmark image on YC page; no description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Launch tagline 'Ironclad for construction', direct and risk-focused

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself. The positioning line is clear but the name is a common word shared with other construction firms.

outcome_analysis: Provision stayed small after the 2022 YC batch, then raised a $7M seed in 2025 led by Cercano, after reporting nearly 10x growth in 2024 and signing large contractors such as PCL, EllisDon and Bird. Better language models gave it a tailwind for contract and drawing review, and enterprise contractor logos suggest a working sales motion. The company is still active and no shutdown or sale was found.
notes: Seed of $7M USD also reported by Axios and One Way Ventures (search results). Round closed in August per BetaKit, article dated 2025-10-15. Total funding $8.7M per BetaKit implies about $1.7M earlier, not itemized. Education not found for either founder. Customer figures on the site are vendor claims. Name origin not found.
